doc: THE LIVE WIRE: free, keyless, first-party official feeds worldwide, polled at sub-hour cadence into desks/mt5/data/news_captures.jsonl, which news_event_stream's fast lane already reads. Edited here, never in code (research/live_wire.py). Only rows whose terms.verdict is OK are requested; every other row is the measured breadth of what was assessed and why it is not polled.
user_agent: quant-desk-livewire/1.0 (public official feeds; honours robots.txt and conditional GET)

probe.why: the build container's egress proxy refused every feed host (connect_rejected), so no robots.txt or HEAD probe could be made from it; URLs marked 'listed on ...' were read off the publisher's own feed-listing page through a research reader, the rest are from memory. Robots is enforced at every fetch on the box through index_discovery.robots_refusal (fail closed) and the result is published per feed in reports/LIVE_WIRE.json

excluded_by_mandate: crypto-exchange websockets and crypto-exchange feeds (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid, Coinbase, Kraken and the rest) are not assessed and never added: the MT5 universe mandate forbids hunting crypto-exchange ground
